newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks decline in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks decline in London trading.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks dropped in London trading on Thursday amid follow-through selling from the Hong Kong session and profit-taking after the market's strong run, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index fell 115.77 points or 0.9 percent to 12,619.49, extending the 0.3 percent drop in the Hang Seng Index in the territory earlier today.
"There was some follow-through selling from Hong Kong and the UK market drifted lower," said one trader. "The market has had a good run and was probably due some profit-taking."
The Hang Seng hit a record close of 12,775.47 on Wednesday.
HSBC led the market lower, down HK$2.25 from the Hong Kong close at HK$160.25, while Amoy Properties was down 10 HK cents at HK$9.40 and New World traded down 20 HK cents at HK$46.60.
